description: Bike Fix It Stations is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. The Austin Parks and Recreation Department (APR) has 14 Bicycle Fix-it Stations at Parks and Recreation facilities all over Austin in an attempt to help promote healthier, more active and sustainable lifestyles for community members of all ages and backgrounds. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Locations and Maps. Its tags are bicycle, station, fix, free, apr. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2024-06-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
